title: Opencode TUI plugin: confirm before exit on Ctrl+C
objective: Add an OpenCode v2 TUI plugin that intercepts Ctrl+C in the Little Mester opencode session and shows a confirmation dialog asking 'are you sure you want to close Little Mester?' before exiting, only closing on confirmed intent.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new TUI plugin at agent/opencode/plugins/little-mester-exit-confirm/ intercepts Ctrl+C in the opencode TUI.
Pressing Ctrl+C shows a confirmation dialog asking whether to close Little Mester; confirming exits, cancelling returns to the session.
The plugin is baked into the agent image (Dockerfile COPY) and registered in opencode.json + tui.json via regen-configs / generated config.
JSX passes tests/tui-jsx.bats (no nested <text>, no bare span fg, no fontWeight style).
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/tui-jsx.bats passes (5/5) including the new plugin JSX

needed: manual check that Ctrl+C triggers confirmation in live opencode session
created: tests/tui-jsx.bats (JSX rule validation for all TUI plugins)
